summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title sequence format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal and buffering Control.title; CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200 (new Added section above Fixed). New tests only: test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not verified: tests were not run, and Black formatting was checked by reading only (longest added lines about 84 characters).
